metadata.purpose: Language-roster reference cut in the Kokoro family: Liam, in for Bear, introduces in English (B00, am_onyx, free), then every voice speaks IN ITS OWN LANGUAGE — an in-language name line plus the localized house tagline, the constant sentence that makes the voices comparable. The group's best-graded voice closes. KokoroRosterCard renders every roster beat; per-voice YouTube chapter markers in the description. Localized lines are machine-authored — FACTCHECK verifies them at build and the description says so. Grades from hexgrad/Kokoro-82M VOICES.md 2026-07-13; ungraded voices stay ungraded. Rides outside the chapter order; cross-links the whole Kokoro roster family.

metadata.description_blurb: Four Romance languages, nine Kokoro voices — Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Italian, and French. Each introduces itself in its own language. Cast by ear.

beats.narration_text: Hey — this is Liam, in for Bear. One video, four Romance languages: Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Italian, and French. Each voice introduces itself in its own language — same house line, different tongue. The French voice, Siwis, is the best-graded non-English voice in the whole Kokoro pack at B minus. The Spanish and Portuguese voices ship ungraded — your ear is the only grade. Cast by ear.
